title: De-Man
tagline: A "Decentralized Management" for for managing employment at an organisation
description:
It allows the Employer of an organisation to onboard multiple employee easily in the organisation and manage all the payrolls.

The Employer need to add sufficient funds to the smart contract for paying the salary of the employees and the smart contract will ensure all the rest of it.

It helps in easy onboarding of the employes and removes to some extent the trust between the Employees and Employer.
how_its_made: A lot of modification needs to be done in the current contract and we wanted to integrate it using biconomy's sign-in with google feature with our project as it will help web2 user who doesnt have knowlege of blockchain too can use such platforms but due to time constraints such features could not be added.
